description: This file defines an abstraction layer for media generation providers, including classes for Fal.ai, LiteLLM, and OpenRouter, with methods for generating images, audio, and videos, as well as transcribing audio. It also includes provider registration and retrieval functions.

classes.name: MediaProvider
classes.description: Abstract base class defining the interface for media generation providers, including methods for image, audio, and video generation, and properties for provider name and supported modalities.

classes.name: FalProvider
classes.description: Implementation of MediaProvider for Fal.ai, supporting image, audio, and video generation, with methods for generating media and transcribing audio.

classes.name: LiteLLMProvider
classes.description: Implementation of MediaProvider using LiteLLM APIs for image and audio generation.

classes.name: OpenRouterProvider
classes.description: Implementation of MediaProvider for OpenRouter, primarily supporting image generation via chat completions.

methods.name: get_provider
methods.description: Factory function to instantiate a provider by name with optional arguments.

methods.name: register_provider
methods.description: Function to register a custom media provider class under a specific name.
